gbifID.description: Unique global occurrence identifier assigned by GBIF for each record.

datasetKey.description: Globally unique identifier linking each record to its originating dataset.

occurrenceID.description: Unique observation URLs linking to iNaturalist or NatureWatch records for each sighting.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom classification for the species, consistently Chromista.

phylum.description: Taxonomic division, uniformly Ochrophyta for all observations.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the organism, consistently Phaeophyceae (brown algae).

order.description: Taxonomic order for all records, Scytosiphonales.

family.description: Taxonomic family classification for the recorded seaweed species.

genus.description: Taxonomic genus of the recorded seaweed, consistently Colpomenia.

species.description: Species name recorded for all observations, always Colpomenia peregrina.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Infraspecific epithet data not recorded for any occurrence.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank consistently recorded as species for all occurrence entries.

scientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded species, consistently Colpomenia peregrina Sauv.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded species, consistently Colpomenia peregrina.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Original taxonomic authorship as recorded in source, currently missing for all

countryCode.description: Two‑letter ISO codes identifying the nation where each occurrence was recorded.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

stateProvince.description: Administrative region (state or province) where each occurrence was recorded.

individualCount.description: Individual count of observed organisms, currently unavailable in the dataset.

publishingOrgKey.description: Identifier of the organization that published the occurrence record.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude of observation in decimal degrees, ranging from -135.846 to 175.811.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty radius in meters for each occurrence record.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision data missing for all records.

elevation.description: Elevation data not recorded for any occurrence.

depth.description: Water column measurement at sampling site, usually expressed in meters.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth measurement accuracy information, currently unavailable for all records.

eventDate.description: Observation timestamps spanning 2009‑2026, recorded with date and time precision.

day.description: Day of month when observation was recorded.

year.description: Calendar year when each occurrence was recorded.

taxonKey.description: Standardized taxonomic identifier used for all Colpomenia peregrina occurrence records.

speciesKey.description: Unique identifier for the recorded species, constant across all records.

basisOfRecord.description: Record source derived from human observation for each occurrence.

institutionCode.description: Data source identifier, consistently iNaturalist for all records.

collectionCode.description: Record type identifier, always set to Observations for each entry.

catalogNumber.description: Unique specimen identifier assigned to each recorded occurrence.

recordNumber.description: Placeholder field with no recorded values.

identifiedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded each Colpomenia peregrina occurrence.

dateIdentified.description: Date and time the occurrence was identified.

license.description: License under which each occurrence record is released, using Creative Commons designations.

rightsHolder.description: Rights holder is the individual or organization owning data usage rights.

sample_values: Santa Barbara Channel Marine Biodiversity Observation Network
recordedBy.description: Names of individuals or entities who recorded each occurrence.

typeStatus.description: All entries are missing, providing no taxonomic status information.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment means data missing for all records.

lastInterpreted.description: Timestamp of last interpretation of the occurrence record.

mediaType.description: Observation media type, primarily still images and related formats.

issue.description: Data quality issues identified during record processing, such as coordinate rounding or missing taxon IDs.

colpomenia_peregrina.description: Colpomenia peregrina occurrence records (2009‑2026) with dates, coordinates, taxonomic details, observer IDs, and metadata.

description: Records of Colpomenia peregrina occurrences from 2009 to 2026 for biodiversity monitoring.
